findings.reason: without the attachment point and a statement of what the guard does for a stale index left between landings that the existing check does not, a node can land a post-landing assertion that closes nothing for the cause its own investigation finds.
findings.text: §33 names three candidate causes but places its guard "after every landing reckon performs", and for the first of them — a promotion that stages its landing writes and is stopped — the stale index arises between landings, so a post-landing check sees it at the same moment `_staged_reversals` (`reckon/crew/promotion_scope.py:2118`, called at the start of `_commit_landing_writes`, :2500) already does, and the plain commit the Why describes still wins the race; no caller is named either, though the landing-commit path (`_commit_landing_writes`) and the fast-forward landing (`land_merge`, `reckon/crew/merge.py:798`, `git merge --ff-only` at :872) are two different attachment points, the second of which the plan itself lists as a candidate cause

rubric_items.anchors_resolve: pass — 379ed481fd, 79ff6bdadf, 91362fd9fc and 0e339294e5 all resolve as commits, §64 of `a-read-answers-inside-its-deadline` resolves at `data-status="done"`, and both write-path modules exist (`reckon/crew/merge.py`, `reckon/crew/promotion_scope.py`).
rubric_items.done_when: pass — the done-when states a reproduction log at the base revision, a new test that drives a temporary repository and a temporary crew home through that sequence, and a negative control that removes the guard so a staged stale copy appears and a following commit reverts a landed path, plus the suite arm, partition and ruff gate.
rubric_items.evidence_paths: pass — every log is under the run directory and the new test lives in `tests/`, both durable.
rubric_items.naming: pass — `tests/test_a_landing_leaves_no_stale_staged_copy.py` names the behaviour, and no plan label, ticket number or version tag reaches a symbol or comment.
rubric_items.reasoning: a finding — §33's guard is placed "after every landing reckon performs", which is the same observation point the existing check already occupies for the first cause the section itself names, and no caller is named.
rubric_items.single_goal: pass — one deliverable, an investigation and the guard it names, with the guard's shape fixed by the investigation's finding.
rubric_items.wiring: pass — §33 declares no `depends-on`, nothing in `plan-section-depends-on` waits on it, and open followup f-tcdiob-033 recommends it, so an independent investigation is wired correctly.
